_meta.name: Attend religious services nearly weekly or more
_meta.unit: percent of valid weighted adult responses
_meta.source: computed from the NORC General Social Survey cumulative microdata (WTSSPS-weighted shares)
_meta.breaks: 2021 push-to-web pandemic design; 2022 and 2024 mixed mode differ from historical in-person interviews.
_meta.note: Computed from cumulative Stata public microdata, WTSSPS-weighted numerator divided by valid weighted denominator, minimum 200 weighted responses per year. ATTEND positive codes 6,7,8 (nearly every week; every week; several times a week); valid codes 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8. Missing years are not interpolated. SOCFREND concerns evenings with friends outside the neighborhood.
